artifact_contract.rule: A serialized model file alone is not a StrongTabularReference-v1 artifact. Feature, data, preprocessing, model, selection, runtime, output and hash identities are all required.
artifact_contract.fitted_artifact_hash_rule: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of the completed fitted manifest after removing only hashes.fitted_artifact_hash; all component hashes must already be populated.

calibration.design_requirement: Any future calibration fit must use companies and time windows disjoint from model development and prospective E5 evaluation.

cross_validation.split_feasibility_rule: Every evaluated fold must contain both endpoint classes; infeasible development data make selection ineligible rather than permitting a weaker split.

CC.row_policy: retain rows with every V feature observed; do not use observability columns as predictors

V.row_policy: all otherwise eligible rows; fold-local imputation without missing indicators

candidate_eligibility: candidate family and all parameters match this config
all outer and inner folds are company-disjoint and endpoint-feasible
every outer observation receives exactly one finite score
no leakage, schema, preprocessing-isolation or provenance check fails
future_model_selection_rule.final_hyperparameter_fit: After family/block selection, run the same grouped inner-CV rule on the complete approved development set, rank grid points by AUROC then PR_AUC then canonical parameter JSON, and fit once on that development set.
future_model_selection_rule.freeze_requirement: This config, feature schema, artifact template, approved development-data manifest and runtime lock must be frozen before candidate evaluation and before any E5 cohort or outcome access.
future_model_selection_rule.objective: Select a competitive reproducible reference on approved development data, not the best result from unrestricted historical tuning.
tie_rule: canonical JSON lexical order as final total-order guard
future_model_selection_rule.winner_record_requirement: The selection record must contain every eligible and failed candidate, fold metrics, selected parameters, ranking keys, integrity findings and the deterministic winner rationale.

imputation.strategy: median for V/VO numeric fields; none for O booleans; none for CC

scaling.policy: standardize logistic numeric inputs; pass observability booleans through; no scaling for histogram gradient boosting

random_seed_policy.derivation: one frozen master seed plus named deterministic child seeds
random_seed_policy.repeat_policy: no seed shopping; all prespecified runs and failures are retained

replay_contract.artifact_guarantee: Serialized files, manifests and selection records must match their recorded SHA-256 exactly.
replay_contract.pinned_runtime_guarantee: Identical ordered inputs under the pinned runtime/container must reproduce score payloads deterministically.
replay_contract.prohibited_claim: Cross-platform byte-identical floating-point inference is not asserted.
verification_order: compare score outputs under the applicable guarantee

scope: Preparatory research infrastructure only; not part of the production FinRisk pipeline.

serialization_security.allowed_origin: trusted repository or release artifact only
